_comment: Canonical lock for the MeepCoin daemon source.
MeepCoin is a PATCH SERIES over an exact, publicly identifiable Monero commit. This file
records the base, the ordered patches, and the identity of the source that results, so a
reviewer can reconstruct the reviewed bytes without trusting one developer's working
directory. node/daemon-source/reconstruct.sh performs and verifies that reconstruction,
and node/daemon-source/verify_lock.py enforces THIS file's declared contract with a real
JSON parser rather than a shell approximation of one.
EVERY COUNT AND LIST HERE IS DERIVED FROM GIT, NOT HAND-MAINTAINED. The previous revision
was hand-counted and drifted: it claimed 20 modified base files when the base-to-final diff
changed 23 paths, and 17 inventory files when there were 19. The three paths it omitted
and src/cryptonote_core/cryptonote_core.cpp. Deleted paths are now a separate list, because
calling a deletion a modification is how that kind of error hides.
SCOPE. This is SOURCE REPRODUCIBILITY. It is not a build, not a test, not a security review,
not a testnet, and not a claim that the resulting daemon is correct or safe to run.

patches.name: 0001-daemon-preserve-current-MeepCoin-source-baseline.patch
patches.purpose: Preserve the exact pre-correction MeepCoin daemon source. No semantic change.

patches.name: 0002-consensus-quarantine-inherited-Monero-trust-anchors.patch
patches.purpose: Remove or fail-close the inherited Monero CONSENSUS trust anchors: the fixed height-202612 long hash, the historical block-id remap, the built-in MAINNET/TESTNET/STAGENET checkpoints, the per-block checkpoint blob, and MoneroPulse checkpoint DNS.

patches.name: 0003-daemon-make-genesis-and-runtime-network-defaults-sel.patch
patches.purpose: Remove the environment-dependent genesis override, and quarantine the inherited Monero RUNTIME contacts: default peer seeds (clearnet DNS, fallback IP, Tor, I2P), the update supply chain, the DNS blocklist authority, and the unsolicited DNSResolver probe.

patches.name: 0004-consensus-fix-the-MeepHash-seed-schedule-and-stop-pr.patch
patches.purpose: Make the MeepHash seed-height schedule a compile-time consensus rule (fixed 2048/64; SEEDHASH_EPOCH_BLOCKS and SEEDHASH_EPOCH_LAG no longer read) and remove the obsolete RandomX block-PoW priming: the four Blockchain lifecycle calls to rx_set_main_seedhash and the built-in miner's rx_set_miner_thread. MeepHash, genesis, vectors, targets, rewards, timestamps and difficulty unchanged.

patches.name: 0005-wallet-stop-logging-true-ring-member-and-amount-at-l.patch
patches.purpose: Delete tools::detail::print_source_entry and both of its call sites (transfer_selected, non-RingCT, and transfer_selected_rct, RingCT). The helper logged the spend amount, real_output, real_output_in_tx_index and every ring member's global output index at LOG_PRINT_L0, which is on by default, so an ordinary wallet log identified the true ring member for every input. Wallet-only: transaction construction, output selection, consensus, MeepHash, rewards, difficulty and daemon behaviour are unchanged.

patches.name: 0006-wallet-remove-the-remaining-automatic-sensitive-log-.patch
patches.purpose: Remove the remaining AUTOMATIC sensitive log payloads inherited from the Monero base, on exceptional and legacy paths that patch 0005 did not cover: the transaction secret key in miner coinbase construction; the true ring position in the input bounds failure; the ring index, true ring position, derived key, real output key, amount, RCT status, real out tx key and real_output_in_tx_index in the derived-key mismatch failure; the tx.version==1 accumulation of every ring public key, every ring signature, the input ephemeral secret key and the true ring position into MCINFO(construct_tx); the automatic transaction_created JSON dump in both construct_tx paths; the view secret key and ephemeral secret key in wallet2 light_wallet_key_image_is_ours; and the transaction private key in device_default output construction. Generic failure text is kept at every site, no level is merely demoted, and simplewallet's explicitly user-requested rpc_payment_info display is deliberately untouched. No consensus, MeepHash, reward, difficulty or control-flow change.

patches.name: 0007-wallet-make-a-fork-scheduled-at-genesis-active-at-ge.patch
patches.purpose: Fix the central wallet fork-rule activation predicate. wallet2::use_fork_rules inherited height >= (int64_t)earliest_height - early_blocks, where early_blocks is a transition offset and Monero's callers pass negative values (-10, -30, -420) to wait that many blocks AFTER a fork. MeepCoin's schedule is one sparse entry (v16 from height 0), so the daemon reports earliest height 0 for every known version and those negative offsets became post-genesis delays for rules that are active in the genesis block: at height 25 the v8 per-byte fee was on while the v4 dynamic fee and the v15 2021 fee scaling were off, so get_base_fee returned the legacy per-kB FEE_PER_KB (2,000,000,000) on the per-byte path and a 1,492-byte, 1 MEEP transfer was priced at 2,984,000,000,000 atomic units against a real 40,000/byte rate, and refused as 'not enough money'. New src/wallet/fork_rules.h holds the whole predicate: an absent fork (uint64 max) is never active, a fork whose earliest height is 0 is active at every height whatever the offset, and any other fork height keeps Monero's semantics exactly, evaluated without wrap-around at either end. No caller, offset, fee constant, hard-fork entry, decimal, reward, difficulty, MeepHash input or daemon-side fee path is changed, and nothing is special-cased for a network, a height or a wallet. Adds the compiled regression meepcoin-fork-activation-test and the static wallet2::estimate_tx_weight_for_shape wrapper it uses to witness the production weight estimator.

patches.name: 0008-tools-add-owned-block-hashing-converter-protocol.patch
patches.purpose: Add a strict bounded stdin/stdout server mode to meepcoin-blockhashing so a future owned pool converter can receive submit-ready full block blobs without exposing them in process arguments. The legacy one-shot vector-tool interface remains available. Tooling only: no consensus rule, daemon path, wallet path, proof-of-work algorithm, reward, difficulty or network default changes.

patch_metadata_note: order, name, sha256 and bytes are ENFORCED by verify_lock.py against the files on disk. wsl_commit is INFORMATIONAL and cannot be reconstructed: it is the commit id in the developer's daemon checkout, and a replay produces its own commit ids. wsl_tree and changed_paths are DESCRIPTIVE cross-checks -- wsl_tree for patch N equals the tree after applying patches 1..N, and the last one equals expected_final_tree, which IS enforced. For patches 4, 5 and 6, wsl_commit is the commit made in the disposable reconstruction where the patch was authored (/home/tseng/meepcoin-seedaudit-20260915T193126Z/src and /home/tseng/meepcoin-patch5-work-20260919T211944Z/src and /home/tseng/meepcoin-patch6-work-20260919T215145Z/src respectively), not in the developer's daemon checkout.
expected_final_commit_note: Commit ids are NOT pinned. reconstruct.sh fixes user.name, user.email and --committer-date-is-author-date, so repeated reconstructions with the same git do produce the same commit ids -- that is a convenience, not the contract, and a different git version may legitimately differ. The TREE and the source-inventory digest are the contract, and they are what is checked.
source_inventory_digest_recipe: sha256 over the sorted '<sha256>  <path>\n' lines of src/crypto/meep-hash.cpp, src/crypto/meep-hash.h and every regular file directly under src/meepcoin_genesis/ (23 files at this revision), sorted by path
baseline_source_inventory_digest_note: The same digest computed at patch 0001 (the preserved pre-correction baseline), when the inventory held 19 files. Recorded so the baseline can be identified independently.
meepcoin_source_inventory_note: The inventory recipe covers src/crypto/meep-hash.{cpp,h} and src/meepcoin_genesis/ only. Patch 0007 also adds src/wallet/fork_rules.h, a MeepCoin file OUTSIDE that recipe: it is listed in added_meepcoin_files and is covered, like every other byte of the result, by expected_final_tree. The recipe is not widened here because its digest is quoted in earlier evidence and widening it silently would make those quotations unverifiable.

meephash_build_inputs.why: The daemon does NOT vendor MeepHash: it compiles the meepow/ tree it is pointed at, via add_subdirectory(${MEEPCOIN_MEEPOW_DIR}). Locking the daemon source while accepting arbitrary proof-of-work bytes would lock the wrong half of the build. reconstruct.sh --meepow <dir> and the container build both verify this manifest before anything is configured or compiled.

monero_checkpoint_blob_note: src/blocks/checkpoints.dat -- the inherited 463364-byte Monero per-block checkpoint blob, sha256 2aea941d43024422a63f223c84b9d88d1f58d31e1f508c2d6d43cd637ba32d16 -- is DELETED by patch 0002. PER_BLOCK_CHECKPOINT is forced off and a cache value asking for it is a fatal configuration error, so the path cannot be re-enabled by accident and has nothing to consume if it were.
consensus_trust_anchors_removed: per-block checkpoint blob and PER_BLOCK_CHECKPOINT (CMakeLists.txt, src/blocks/checkpoints.dat)
MoneroPulse checkpoint DNS acquisition and --enforce-dns-checkpointing (src/checkpoints/checkpoints.cpp, src/cryptonote_core/blockchain.cpp, src/cryptonote_core/cryptonote_core.cpp)
runtime_contacts_removed: sixteen hard-coded fallback IP seeds on ports 18080/28080/38080 (src/p2p/net_node.inl)
six Monero onion seeds and three I2P seeds (src/p2p/net_node.inl)

seven updates.moneropulse.* endpoints and the getmonero.org download bases; --check-updates defaults to disabled and any other value is refused (src/common/updates.cpp, src/cryptonote_core/cryptonote_core.cpp, src/rpc/core_rpc_server.cpp)
the unsolicited updates.moneropulse.org probe in the DNSResolver constructor and its hidden public-resolver fallback (src/common/dns_utils.cpp)
consensus_determinism_and_inherited_work: environment-dependent MeepHash seed schedule: rx_seedheight()/rx_seedheights() read SEEDHASH_EPOCH_BLOCKS and SEEDHASH_EPOCH_LAG; now fixed 2048/64 (src/crypto/rx-slow-hash.c)
RandomX main-cache/dataset priming for block PoW in Blockchain::init, pop_blocks, switch_to_alternative_blockchain and handle_block_to_main_chain (src/cryptonote_core/blockchain.cpp)
RandomX miner-thread flag and full-dataset allocation in the built-in miner (src/cryptonote_basic/miner.cpp)
retained_and_why: BlockchainDB::fixup() is retained UNCHANGED. Its body is gated on the height-0 block hash equalling Monero's mainnet genesis 418015bb...32e3; the MeepCoin genesis ids are 5ee18340..., 871bc633... and 825a2f71..., so it is unreachable for a correctly initialized MeepCoin database. That is a statement about a correctly initialized database, NOT a claim that it is impossible to execute against a deliberately foreign one whose height-0 block is Monero's genesis.
Locally supplied checkpoints.json remains a deliberate, operator-controlled checkpoint input. What was removed is the BUILT-IN and DNS checkpoint sources, not every checkpoint mechanism.

Wallet donation branding, research-paper citations, hardware-wallet and protobuf/Trezor compatibility names, internal MONERO_* build symbols, namespaces and cryptographic domain separators are inherited and UNCHANGED. Renaming them is a separate design decision with real compatibility consequences, not a cleanup.

src/debug_utilities/dns_checks.cpp still names MoneroPulse and moneroseeds hosts. It is a separate diagnostic executable that is not linked into meepcoind and runs only when a developer invokes it. Left for a later phase.

RandomX hashing for RPC PAYMENTS is retained: src/rpc/rpc_payment.cpp (daemon, only with an RPC-payment address) and src/wallet/wallet_rpc_payments.cpp (wallet client). It is not block proof-of-work. Without the removed priming it uses RandomX's secondary light-mode cache for the requested seed.
rx_set_main_seedhash(), rx_set_miner_thread(), rx_slow_hash() and external/randomx are retained, uncalled or RPC-payment-only; purging the library is not part of this change.
core::get_block_sync_size() still reads SEEDHASH_EPOCH_BLOCKS. It clamps how many blocks one sync request may carry and changes no seed height or proof-of-work.

exclusions.reason: A separate nested checkout, not a submodule of this base and not referenced by any MeepCoin source file. Vendoring it would silently enlarge the reviewed surface.
Local build output. Never part of the locked source.

not_established: This lock says nothing about whether the daemon builds, runs, or is correct.
It is not a security review, a testnet, a network, or a monetary claim.
One build from these sources does not make the resulting binary reproducible. That would require two independent clean builds producing identical artifacts, which has not been done.
Network branding and the debug-only DNS utility remain inherited and are a later phase.
publication_note: This distribution omits documentation files and review-attribution metadata. Patch message metadata and archive checksums are repackaged. Patch diff payloads, the expected final source tree, and MeepHash build-input pins are unchanged.
